title: Event envelope
description: Body of every event published to a service's existing event stream. Events may be delivered more than once: deduplicate on `event_id`. `occurred_at` does not establish a global order; ordering is guaranteed only among events of one partition (the resource named in the subject), in publish order. The final element of `causal_path` must equal `event_id` (checked by `tooling/validate.py`). Service schemas fix `event_type` and `producer` and narrow `resources` and `payload` with `allOf`.

event_type.description: Dotted `{family}.{fact}` name; the schema discriminator. The tokens after the subject's last resource ID end it: the whole name (`…{job_id}.job.created`) or its fact (`…{invocation_id}.blocked-auth`).

resource_version.description: Version of the partition resource after this event, where that resource is versioned.

operation_ref.description: The command and operation an event completes or reports on. Present in completion events whose cause is a command.

headers.description: NATS headers sent with every event, with the trace context of the work that published it.

Nats-Msg-Id.description: Equal to `event_id`, so JetStream drops republication within the stream's 2-minute duplicate window.
